run_training_C3DPO: run the C3DPO model training loop with a config object that specifies dataset, solver, and model parameters
init_model_from_dir: initialize a C3DPO model from an experiment directory by loading its config file and checkpoint
init_optimizer: create an SGD, Adagrad, or Adam optimizer with a multistep learning rate scheduler for the model
run_experiment_from_cfg_file: run a full training experiment by loading an experiment config from a YAML file path
run_eval: run evaluation on a test dataset loader using the trained model and return results as a dictionary
